dataset: Rossmann existing 400-store panel; target Sales is turnover, not unit demand
availability: Promo/Open/holidays treated as preannounced plans; archive contains realized fields, no vintage plans. Promo2 only enrolled at origin; competitor future status held at origin. Store metadata snapshot not historically versioned. Customers excluded.
state_model: Joint linear Gaussian damped-level/Fourier regression; weekly K3, trend disabled as previous Rossmann benchmark; store-specific regression coefficients; Open used as structural gate
lgbm: Existing full benchmark independently rerun at o900; extended-factor LightGBM fixed 600 trees same training-origin rows; no test tuning
ablations: State-Fourier old; same new sampler with no exog/open; Open only; six factors; remove each five regression groups (Open kept). Fixed selected full-model hyperparameters for group ablations.
metric: Mean per-store WAPE, equal origins; pooled aggregate WAPE separately. Store-cluster bootstrap averaged over origins; cannot represent unseen-date uncertainty.
selection_note: Previously inspected outer windows; exploratory retrospective extension, not new blind validation
